svg.title: Bifurcation diagram for the logistic map
svg.desc: Long-run values of x under the logistic map x -> mu x (1 - x) for mu from 0 to 4. x = 0 for mu up to 1, then a single branch x = 1 - 1/mu rising to 2/3 at mu = 3, where it splits into a period-2 pair, then period 4 near 3.45, then a cascade of period doublings into chaos past about 3.57, with periodic windows such as the period-3 window near 3.83.
